title: Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity: A Constructive Refutation of Objectivist Primacy from Source-Derived Quantum Dynamics to the Einstein Limit
description: We develop Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity as a candidate theory in which a public spacetime carrier is generated by intersections of nonidentical, standpoint-bearing Braid processes rather than assumed as an ontologically prior container. Version 0.81 retains the source-derived continuous metric/nonmetricity tensor, Hilbert stress, Ward identity, scoped Einstein equation G=(3/5)T, and two-helicity massless spin-2 limit. It adds a finite source-cylinder completion in the aligned four-score, block-local identity-feedback class: the source-fixed raw/Petz record contrast derives all four interaction-stress defects, a local recorded Lorentzian CTP parent, an exact history-dressed four-component Ward law, and one parameter-free CPTP matter-geometry-matter cycle. The direct finite Fisher relative coefficient is 1 and is not yet identified with the distinct full-corner routing ratio 3/5 used in the continuum theorem. Full nonlinear finite gravity, gravitational first-class constraints, absolute calibration, Standard-Model matter, ultraviolet completion, and empirical validation remain open. The construction refutes the universal necessity thesis of objectivist primacy; it does not refute mind-independent reality, establish consciousness, or show that nature realizes the model.
